notes: One-click in-app updates with installer checksum verification. Reorganized Settings into eight sections; added separate Controls, Integrations, and Diagnostics pages. Combat Assist can show boss casts and cooldowns together or separately. Locked-meter help now stays visible with Alt+click and the current hotkey; Alt+click unlock is fixed. Improved same-class party and Spiritmaster tracking, isolated personal buffs, corrected shared target Insignia stacks, and updated mixed-effect skill choices. Settings now recover from an old small saved window size, and the meter has a compact frameless resize grip.
